notes:
I found two Ottawa venues that are open year-round and good for young children. Neither has posted hours for September 4–6, 2027, so I've given their current regular hours. Those hours may change by then.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Canada Science and Technology Museum",
      "source_name": "Ingenium – Canada's Museums of Science and Innovation",
      "source_url": "https://ingenium.ca/scitech/en/visit/",
      "name_evidence": "Discover all you need to know before your visit to the Canada Science and Technology Museum in Ottawa",
      "when": "Currently posted hours: Tuesday to Sunday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., closed Mondays; the page says the museum is open on statutory holidays except December 25. Hours for September 4–6, 2027 (a Saturday to Monday, with Monday being Labour Day) could not be confirmed. The museum's own social post says it is closed Mondays until April 30, 2027.",
      "schedule_kind": "hours",
      "when_evidence": "The museum is open on statutory holidays, except December 25."
    },
    {
      "name": "Canada Agriculture and Food Museum",
      "source_name": "Ingenium – Canada's Museums of Science and Innovation",
      "source_url": "https://ingenium.ca/agriculture/en/",
      "name_evidence": "Visit the Canada Agriculture and Food Museum, a working farm in the heart of Ottawa that features animal barns, daily cooking demonstrations, and family-friendly exhibitions about agriculture in Canada.",
      "when": "Currently posted hours: Wednesday to Sunday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. That covers Saturday and Sunday, September 4–5. Monday, September 6 is not in the posted days. Hours for September 2027 could not be confirmed.",
      "schedule_kind": "hours",
      "when_evidence": "Open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Wednesday to Sunday"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Age fit:** Neither page names a preschool age range, so I left `age_fit` out. The Agriculture and Food Museum page calls itself "family-friendly" and describes animal barns, which suits young children.
- **Price:** Neither page states a price for a regular visit that I could use. The Science and Technology Museum says admission is free daily from 4 to 5 p.m., but I left that out as a price.
- **Other venues I looked at but left out:**
  - **Canadian Museum of Nature:** the only page of its own that I could read covers group admission, not family visits. I only saw its general hours on third-party sites.
  - **Valleyview Little Animal Farm:** the farm's own site says it is open May to October. Its 2026 season ends October 31, and it plans to reopen on Easter weekend, March 26, 2027. It posts no hours for September 2027.
